Resolves #19039

Four arms went red and then green on rerun, across three tiers, on 2026-09-21, and they produced **no rate**: the tiers they sit on have no way to measure one. `test-e2e.yml` has carried #18505's dispatch instrument since it was built, but `test.yml`, which owns `unit`, `unit-tz` and `components`, never got it. A rerun is the opposite of a sample: it marks the run green and erases the observation that provoked it.

Evidence: L3 (hosted dispatches of this branch at `1e92e32f98`, receipts below) → L3 required (AC-2, AC-3 and AC-4 are claims about hosted runs).

**Change class: `ci`, declared.** `pull_request` and `push` behave as before. The dispatch path is new capability for a workflow, not product behaviour. `agent-preflight: not hosted here` (`ABSENT` in this `package.json`).

## What shipped

- `workflow_dispatch` with `specs` and `repeatEach`, **named as in `test-e2e.yml`** so the tiers stay comparable. Also a `suite` input, because this file is a matrix over three tiers.
- Dispatch-keyed `concurrency`, so two probes cannot cancel each other. Copied from `test-e2e.yml`, which learned it mid-measurement.
- Inputs reach the shell as **environment**, never interpolated into `run:`.
- `specs` takes **paths only**: an option token fails the step before Playwright runs. Word-split, `--list` collected the whole tier, executed nothing and exited 0 ([Emmy's control](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/35800607801), at `b94bafd21a`).
- The probe summary reports **Playwright's own tally**, tee'd from the run, next to the requested repeat. A run that never reached its reporter says so instead of printing a count. `set -o pipefail` keeps `tee` from masking a red suite.

No classifier bypass: `classify-test-scope.yml` fails open on a dispatch (no changed files → every run flag `true`), and the head check returns `true` for any non-`pull_request` event. The AC-2 receipt below confirms it: the no-specs dispatch executed the tier.

## Deltas from ticket

- The ticket's original classifier-bypass AC is struck: the source fails open, so there is nothing to bypass.
- The `suite` input has no counterpart in `test-e2e.yml`; it exists because this file is a three-tier matrix.

## Test Evidence

- **Paths only:** [35803624126](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/35803624126), `specs=--list` → `##[error]specs takes spec paths only; '--list' is a Playwright option`, exit 1, before Playwright starts. On each job the report step then ran (`success`); the job summary itself is not readable through the API.
- **Both step scripts,** run locally in bash against a stubbed `npm`: `--list` and `-g` are rejected; two paths become two arguments; no specs builds only the shard; a red suite exits 1 through the `tee`. The report quotes the tally lines, or `no Playwright summary line — the run did not reach its reporter` when there is no log.

## Post-Merge Validation

- [ ] **AC-6:** run the instrument against `dashboard/DockTabReorderGesture`, `data/TreeStoreValueBanding` and `core/DistEsmWorkspaceBoot`, and record each denominator on @neo-opus-ada's intermittents notes rather than on the arms' own PRs.
